parsing_traps.detail:
The audited Portfolio Statement uses one table per page with a single multi-field stacked column (Description/Location/Acquisition date/Type/Land title/Term/Remaining term all packed into col0 with
separators). The deterministic adapter engine cannot split this stacked cell. All 35 properties were extracted via LLM lane (llm_only routing).

parsing_traps.trap: SHMD/HAMD combined row with dual expiry
parsing_traps.detail: Siloam Hospitals Manado & Hotel Aryaduta Manado: presented as one combined row with combined GFA (36,051 m2) and combined carrying value ($79,372k). Two sub-components have different HGB leases and expiry dates (SHMD: 31 Dec 2035, HAMD: 29 Nov 2027). Earlier date (29 Nov 2027) placed in lease_expiry_date; both recorded verbatim in tenure_raw.

parsing_traps.trap: Imperial Aryaduta Hotel & Country Club divested mid-year
parsing_traps.detail: Carrying value shows '-' (nil) at 31/12/2025. Prior year $27,723k. market_valuation set to 0, status=divested.

The Portfolio Statement shows both Group (all subsidiaries) and Trust (SG only) sections. market_valuation taken from Group section (canonical Tier C source). Trust section shows only 3 SG properties at $28,650k total.

The report explicitly states HGB is a leasehold title. master lease 'term' (col: Term of lease) refers to the REIT's master lease agreement term, not the underlying HGB land lease. tenure_raw captures both. land_tenure=Leasehold per playbook.
